name: shokker-paint-booth-local
description: Private local pilot for the existing Shokker Paint Booth MCP bridge.

interface.longDescription: Control an already-running Shokker Paint Booth through its existing local MCP bridge. Includes SPB painting instructions and the dependency-free Node adapter. Requires Windows, Node.js, SPB Pro mode and the assistant bridge enabled. This private pilot does not embed the SPB editor or connect ChatGPT web to your computer.
defaultPrompt: Using Shokker Paint Booth, inspect my current car and suggest a livery using real finishes from its catalog.
Using Shokker Paint Booth, help me edit my paint and inspect the paint and spec previews after each change.
